source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The rename listener updates JSONFile data and schedules saveSoon. Its shared assertColor helper checks getColor under the new and old URI keys and the row icon inline --icon-color value. Those assertions cover the loaded cache and row refresh; the test does not flush and reopen folderTree.json or restart the store. Keep this direct coverage separate from durable disk-persistence validation or computed visual-color/accessibility results. No browser test or file reload ran.
title: The folder-color rename test checks cache and row state without reloading its JSON file
